records.text: Pioneer Systems canceled -- anyone have context on what happened?

records.subject: Confirming cancellation for Pioneer Systems
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Confirming the cancellation on our end. We're sorry Wrenfield didn't end up being the right fit for Pioneer Systems -- the door's open if that changes.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Checking in on Pioneer Systems' setup
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

How's Wrenfield treating you this week? If there's a specific workflow you're trying to replicate from your old tool, I'm happy to help map it over.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Pioneer Systems!
records.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero product activity: no project, no invite, no milestone, and no tickets. Two Wrenfield outreaches (email:9c51d84b, email:d65e6c7c) went unanswered, so no signal of intent beyond the active Team plan. Silence plus total inactivity makes unaided activation in 8 days unlikely, though the paid Team plan keeps it nonzero.

draft.subject: A hand getting Pioneer Systems' first project up
draft.body:
Hi Ahmed,

Following up on my last note — I know the first week gets busy, so I'll keep this short.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project in place is usually the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week work? I'm glad to walk through your first project with you and answer anything about setting the team up.

Best,
Chidi
